assets.name: 00-pair-hero
assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Premium photographic CGI transparent hero cutout for a website/product video. Input image 1 is the exact exterior CYMBA earbud identity and input2 the inner geometry. Show a matched LEFT and RIGHT PAIR of these compact premium wired earbuds, floating side by side with restrained stagger, same scale. Left earbud shows its oval charcoal outside faceplate with thin champagne-gunmetal rim, right earbud shows its inward side with TWO larger stimulation contacts on soft wing base, ONE distinct rectangular optical PPG window (sensor-equipped ear only), and TWO smaller flush EEG contact areas on the silicone tip. Same compact smoky black shell, curved matte black silicone concha wing, shallow dark-grey soft tip, fine realistic textures. No over-ear cables: each black braided cable exits its BOTTOM strain relief, drops gracefully down and exits lower canvas edge. No inline controller. Portraits of actual consistent manufactured-looking same-design pair, no artistic redesign.
Transparent alpha background. Landscape16:9 highest native resolution. Balanced composition with two earbuds centered across x=34% and x=67%; no overlap, wide generous transparent outer margins, all tips and wings visible. Each body 65% canvas height. Neutral large softbox upper-left, soft fill right; no extreme reflections, full sharp focus. No floor, shadow, backdrop, checkerboard, gradient. No text, arrows, labels, marks, watermark, extra components or glowing lights.

assets.name: 01-outer-face
assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE high-end photorealistic CGI frame for a product orbit video. Image 1 is the exact locked product identity, materials, lighting and image framing; image 2 is the reverse-side geometry reference of the SAME earbud. Preserve this exact single cable-down earbud, no redesign. True transparent alpha background. Wide 16:9, highest native resolution.
INVARIANTS: compact smoky translucent black acoustic shell; oval matte charcoal faceplate and thin champagne-gunmetal metal rim; ONE curved soft matte black concha wing on top; ONE shallow smoke-grey silicone acoustic tip; exactly TWO smaller satin-gold dry EEG contact areas flush in the outer skin-facing tip surface, not on a separate metal collar. Exactly TWO larger isolated stimulation pads on the inner wing base. ONE separate recessed rectangular inward-facing PPG sensor window beside those pads. Single bottom black strain relief and black braided cable hanging straight DOWN to the lower frame edge. No over-ear cable. No controller, spare parts or second earbud.
MATCH Image 1's macro product quality, light direction from upper-left, neutral tone, fine dark silicone texture, metallic edge width and shell proportions. Keep world vertical upright and orbit around the vertical axis only, constant lens distance and camera height; do not tilt, roll or mirror. Same apparent physical scale and product center as Image 1. All of wing, tip and shell in frame. Crisp full-product focus. Empty pixels truly alpha=0, no floor, shadow, glow, backdrop, checkerboard, text, labels, arrows, logos or watermarks.
SHOT: Exterior face-on starting view: turn the same earbud approximately 40 degrees from Image 1 until the broad oval OUTWARD faceplate looks straight toward the viewer, faceplate fully readable and nearly symmetric; the rear nozzle and tip mostly disappear behind its right edge, the curved silicone wing remains above and bottom cable below. The inner stimulation pads and PPG must be hidden on the rear surface, never added to the outward faceplate.

assets.name: 02-outer-three-quarter
assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Create a premium photorealistic CGI product video keyframe, on a GENUINELY TRANSPARENT ALPHA background, of exactly one CYMBA concept wired earbud. Reference image 1 is the exterior industrial-design identity, reference image 2 is the SAME PRODUCT's inward surface identity. Rebuild it faithfully with refined precision; do not redesign it.
SHOT: exterior three-quarter hero view matching reference 1: oval graphite faceplate toward front-left camera, narrow satin champagne-gunmetal rim, compact smoky translucent black shell, short acoustic nozzle and soft shallow smoke-grey silicone tip extending to image right. A single curved matte black silicone concha wing rises from the top. Cable exits the BOTTOM strain relief and hangs down, never over the ear. One short length of black braided cable continues out through the bottom canvas edge. No controller or second earbud.
IDENTITY: on the hidden inner side of the removable wing base are exactly TWO isolated satin gold stimulation contacts, a distinct recessed rectangular PPG window on the inner shell; TWO much smaller dry EEG contact areas embedded flush in the exterior skin-contact surface of the replaceable silicone tip (only show if physically visible from this angle). No lights or extra electronics.
COMPOSITION: landscape 16:9 master, highest available native resolution, ideally 3840x2160. Body centered at x=50%, y=46%, earbud body excluding cable occupies about 48% of canvas height. Whole tip, fin and faceplate within frame; ample empty transparent margins for later explosion. Straight upright world vertical, fixed 85mm macro product lens perspective, no diagonal product tilt. Extremely crisp fine texture, clean engineering seams, precise soft silicone, optically convincing dark translucent resin and restrained metallic rim.
LIGHT: large neutral softbox upper-left, gentle white fill right and restrained rim highlight; studio light fixed relative to camera; clear readable dark forms on both dark and light web backgrounds. Full-product focus, no blur or bokeh.
BACKGROUND: actual alpha=0 empty pixels, no floor, no cast shadow, no backdrop, no white rectangle and absolutely no visible checkerboard pattern. No text, labels, numbers, branding, arrows, diagram lines or watermarks. This is a consistent industrial-design visualization, not a claim of a validated internal layout.

assets.name: 05-explosion-ready
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Create a matching keyframe for this exact transparent product-explosion sequence. Image1 is the FULLY EXPLODED endpoint and determines camera, framing, component identity and lighting; image2 is the same earbud assembled, for exterior fit and seams. True alpha transparent background; same landscape16:9 canvas, maximum native detail. Keep main shell's center at approximately x=65%, y=61%, its apparent size, PPG window, bottom strain relief and braided cable position FIXED as in Image1. Camera and light absolutely fixed. Cable hangs down and exits bottom. Exact same smoky black shell, charcoal faceplate, thin champagne rim, grey tip, curved black wing. Do not introduce any new or duplicate parts. EEG pads must move with silicone tip, exactly TWO larger stimulation contacts with removable wing, PPG remains inward-facing on shell. Crisp clean silhouette with smooth antialiasing, no white matte, no red/magenta/cyan color fringe, no isolated pixels. No text, labels, arrows, inset, floor, cast shadow or background pattern.
FRAME STATE: COMPLETELY ASSEMBLED, zero gaps. Reassemble all the detached parts from Image1 into the closed earbud body, with the tip extending to LEFT from the shell, outer faceplate closed on RIGHT and soft wing seated on TOP. The one audio driver and acoustic nozzle are now correctly inside the housing/tip and must NOT appear as floating parts. No flex tails exposed. Show exactly the assembled geometry of Image2, but at Image1's SMALLER shell size, perspective and screen anchor. This is the wider static starting frame immediately before the explosion; preserve all surrounding empty transparent room that the exploded components will occupy. Do not enlarge or recenter product to fill the canvas. ONE small assembled earbud on the right of the wide frame, with broad empty transparent area to the left.

Components correctly sized to fit inside this shell, driver smaller than faceplate, no glows.
